title: FlameMod
description: My first attempt at making a mod! Here you have a sword and a pickaxe that each do unique things!
body: This is my attempt at making my own custom mod. This is not the best mod ever, but it includes a Flame sword and pickaxe that each have their own special ability. Try to see if you can figure them out! This mod is still in early progress so do not expect much from the mod such as with it changing your minecraft experience. This mod will also be mainly in Neoforge because it is much easier to work with. I just hope you enjoy it!
